findings.summary: Initial patch did not build because RankerLearningEvidenceResult lacked Request while CLI/tests dereferenced it.
Missing context_pack_id is now a blocker, not an informational finding.
Ranker-learning evidence text output now includes typed findings as well as blockers and next action.
Path blocker taxonomy is aligned with focused adapter and CLI tests.
Ranker-learning evidence mode rejected `.idiom/ranker/weights.json` and other ranker state paths after review found the adapter could emit them in request.files.
Ranker-learning evidence mode now rejects a full product-feedback JSON wrapper when the top-level status is blocked, even if the nested summary status is pass.

idiom tool context_query --input '{"query":"ranker learning product workflow feedback evidence adapter verified context test outcomes no promotion","resolution":"symbol","limit":12}'
JSON/JSONL validation for durable workflow artifacts
privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts
residual_risk: Unresolved context gaps are surfaced as warnings rather than blockers because the active effort still carries historical stale runtime trace notes unrelated to this atom; a future policy atom can decide whether any unresolved context gap should block ranker evidence. The review-found fail-open paths for ranker state paths and blocked wrapper status are covered by focused adapter and CLI regressions.
